LC 46 1255S The House Resolution 429 By: Representatives Martin of Committee on Rules offers the 49th, Parsons of the 44th, Drenner of the 85th, Crowe of the 118th, and Cannon of the 172nd following substitute to HR 429:
A RESOLUTION
Creating the House Study Committee on Funding for Next Generation 9-1-1; and for other purposes.
WHEREAS, the State of Georgia's current 9-1-1 system does not fully realize the advancements in technology and communications to serve … authorized by the Georgia General Assembly in 1977; and
WHEREAS, it is in the best interest of the State of Georgia and its residents to establish a committee dedicated to a comprehensive review of the state's current 9-1-1 funding LC 46 1255S
provisions and to study and identify any reforms necessary to provide adequate funding to support the transition from legacy 9-1-1 centers to modern Next Generation 9-1-1 centers in a manner that will ensure that their current and future operations … members of the committee shall receive the allowances provided for in Code Section 28-1-8 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated. The allowances authorized by this resolution shall not be received by any member of the committee for more than five three days unless additional days are authorized. Funds necessary to carry out the provisions of this resolution shall come from funds appropriated to the House of Representatives. LC 46 1255S
(6) Report. (A) In the event the committee adopts any specific findings or recommendations that include suggestions for proposed legislation, the chairperson shall file a report of the same prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution, … approved report, the chairperson may file with the Clerk of the House of Representatives a copy of the minutes of the meetings of the committee in lieu thereof. (7) Abolishment. The committee shall stand abolished on December 1, 2025.
